diff --git a/.stylelintignore b/.stylelintignore
old mode 100644
new mode 100755
index ab7936902db..1d2533ce343
--- a/.stylelintignore
+++ b/.stylelintignore
@@ -30,4 +30,3 @@ suite/**
 
 # Empty file to ignore
 mail/components/im/messages/simple/Variants/Normal.css
-
diff --git a/.stylelintrc.js b/.stylelintrc.js
old mode 100644
new mode 100755
index 75904fca233..bbdba060ff4
--- a/.stylelintrc.js
+++ b/.stylelintrc.js
@@ -14,7 +14,12 @@ function readFile(filePath) {
     .readFileSync(filePath, { encoding: "utf-8" })
     .split("\n")
     .filter(p => p && !p.startsWith("#"))
-    .map(p => p.replace(/^comm\//, ""));
+    .map(p => p.replace(/^comm\//, ""))
+    .map(p =>
+      !path.basename(p).includes(".") && !p.includes("*")
+        ? path.join(p, "**")
+        : p
+    );
 }
 
 const ignoreFiles = [
